01
MANUAL SCOPE

概述Overview

维修手册适用范围、人员要求与使用原则。Scope, personnel requirements, and usage principles of the service manual.

本维修手册提供了九号滑板车 G3荷兰版 有关功能原理图、维修注意事项、组成部分、拆装等技术信息。经九号培训合格并授权的维修人员在理解本手册后，方可为 G3荷兰版 进行维修。This service manual provides technical information for the Segway Kickscooter G3 Netherlands version, including functional diagrams, service precautions, component structure, and disassembly/assembly procedures. Only trained and authorized Segway service personnel may perform repairs after understanding this manual.

本手册在经测试证明有效的技术的基础上，提供了完成维修的基本说明。按照本手册进行维修可提高工作的可靠性。This manual provides the basic instructions required to complete repairs based on techniques proven effective through testing. Following this manual can improve repair reliability.

!

本手册中的诊断及维修程序，仅供具备相关资格的专业技师使用。在未接受相关培训及未使用合适工具和设备的情况下进行车辆诊断及维修，可能对本人、他人或车辆造成安全隐患。The diagnostic and repair procedures in this manual are intended only for qualified service technicians. Performing diagnostics or repairs without proper training, tools, or equipment may create safety risks for the technician, other people, or the vehicle.

02
SAFETY GUIDANCE

安全指导与维修说明Safety Guidelines & Service Instructions

维修场地、个人防护、工具和专业维修要求。Requirements for the service area, personal protection, tools, and professional service work.

安全指导Safety Guidelines

  1. 选择通风、干燥、无易燃易爆物品的场地，禁止在潮湿地面、密闭空间或火源附近维修。Select a ventilated, dry work area free of flammable or explosive materials. Do not perform repairs on a wet floor, in an enclosed space, or near an ignition source.
  2. 作业台需平整，周围无杂物堆积，避免维修工具或零件滚落伤人。The workbench must be level and the surrounding area must be kept clear to prevent tools or parts from rolling off and causing injury.
  3. 维修前必须穿戴绝缘手套，尤其接触电池、主板时；拆卸金属部件时建议佩戴防割手套。Wear insulated gloves before service work, especially when handling the battery or main board. Cut-resistant gloves are recommended when removing metal parts.
  4. 长发需束起，禁止穿宽松衣物、拖鞋作业，防止衣物卷入车轮或机械结构。Tie back long hair. Do not wear loose clothing or slippers during service work to prevent clothing from being caught in the wheels or mechanical structure.
  5. 禁止酒后、疲劳状态下进行维修操作。Do not perform service work while under the influence of alcohol or when fatigued.
  6. 使用绝缘手柄的维修工具，工具需完好无破损，禁止使用生锈、变形工具。Use service tools with insulated handles. Tools must be intact and undamaged. Do not use rusty or deformed tools.
  7. 禁止拆解电池包外壳；若电池鼓包、漏液、破损，应立即停止使用并联系官方售后处理。Do not disassemble the battery pack housing. If the battery is swollen, leaking, or damaged, stop using it immediately and contact authorized after-sales service.

维修说明Service Instructions

  1. 本维修手册中的诊断及维修程序，仅供具备相关资格的专业技师使用。The diagnostic and repair procedures in this service manual are intended only for qualified professional technicians.
  2. 在实施某些维修步骤时，请务必使用合格的专用工具和指定设备。When performing certain service procedures, be sure to use qualified special tools and the specified equipment.

04
TERMINOLOGY

术语解释Terminology

维修手册中常见简写、缩略文字及专业术语。Common abbreviations, shortened terms, and technical terminology used in the service manual.

名词Term解释Definition
启动速度Starting Speed骑行者需要先用脚蹬地使滑板车达到一定的滑行速度，例如：当车速达到 3km/h 时，油门才能驱动电机工作The rider must first push the scooter with one foot until it reaches a certain rolling speed. For example, when the speed reaches 3 km/h, the throttle can drive the motor.
能量回收Energy Recovery将动能转化为电能的技术，有助于提高车辆的续航能力A technology that converts kinetic energy into electrical energy and helps improve the scooter's range.
骑行模式Riding Mode适应不同骑行者的需求，提供更加安全和便利的骑行体验Adapts to the needs of different riders and provides a safer and more convenient riding experience.
定速巡航Cruise Control车辆达到并保持一定速度后，允许骑行暂时放开油门控制，而车辆会自动保持当前速度继续前行After the scooter reaches and maintains a certain speed, the rider can temporarily release the throttle and the scooter will automatically maintain the current speed.
灯光设置Lighting Settings通过 APP 进行调节，以满足不同骑行需求和个性化展示Adjusted through the APP to meet different riding requirements and personalized display preferences.
警戒模式Guard Mode用于在滑板车不被使用或者停放时保护它免受盗窃或未授权移动的风险Used to protect the scooter from theft or unauthorized movement when it is not in use or is parked.
灯效Lighting Effects灯光效果，前灯、尾灯、氛围灯等Lighting effects for the headlight, taillight, ambient light, etc.
氛围灯Ambient Light适应自身要求的灯光效果Lighting effects configured to meet the rider's own preferences.
开/关机Power On/Off启动/关闭车辆电源Turns the scooter power on or off.
零速启动Zero-Speed Start车辆在静置状态下直接加速起步，无需预先蹬地滑行来获得动力Allows the scooter to accelerate directly from a standstill without first pushing off with the foot to obtain drive power.
充电上限Charging Limit在电池充电时设置一个上限，以限制电池的充电水平Sets an upper limit during battery charging to limit the battery charge level.
刹车优先Brake Priority刹车时切换电机供电Switches the motor power supply when braking.
自定义档位速度Custom Gear Speed根据个人需求选择合适的档位，以适应不同的骑行环境Allows the rider to select an appropriate gear according to personal needs and different riding environments.
电子刹车强度Electronic Braking Strength刹车系统在减速时所施加的力量大小The amount of braking force applied by the braking system during deceleration.
车辆总里程Total Mileage车辆累计行驶的距离总数The total accumulated distance traveled by the scooter.
车辆温度scootertemperature控制器温度传感器检测到的温度The temperature detected by the controller temperature sensor.
主控Main Controller实现车辆的智能控制和稳定性，负责整合和管理车辆的各项功能Provides intelligent control and stability for the scooter and is responsible for integrating and managing its functions.
电池Battery为车辆提供动力，确保车辆的续航能力和安全性，支撑车辆的综合性能Provides power to the scooter, supports range and safety, and contributes to overall scooter performance.
蓝牙Bluetooth用于智能连接和控制，提供与智能手机的交互能力Used for smart connection and control, providing interaction with a smartphone.
爬坡角度Climbing Angle车辆能上坡的极限坡度The limiting slope that the scooter can climb.
最大爬坡度Maximum Climbing Grade车辆能够爬升的最大坡度角度The maximum slope angle that the scooter can climb.
最大速度Maximum Speed车辆在特定条件下能够达到的最高速率或者最快移动速度The highest speed the scooter can reach under specified conditions.
最大功率Maximum Power电源在单位时间内，电路元件上能量的最大变化量The maximum change in energy per unit time at a circuit element.
电池标称容量Rated Battery Capacity电池在特定放电条件下能够提供的电量The amount of electric charge the battery can provide under specified discharge conditions.
电机标称电压Rated Motor Voltage电机的额定工作电压，也被称为额定电压The rated operating voltage of the motor, also referred to as the rated voltage.
理论续航Theoretical Range车辆在特定测试条件下，设备能够持续运行的最长时间或者距离The maximum operating time or distance the scooter can achieve under specified test conditions.
工况续航Operating-Condition Range车辆在实际道路条件下的续航能力The scooter's range under actual road conditions.
充电时长Charging Time电池从 0% 充到 100% 所需要的时间The time required to charge the battery from 0% to 100%.
续航（剩余）Remaining Range当前电量下车辆能够继续行驶的距离The distance the scooter can continue to travel at the current battery level.
骑行时间Riding Time在一定电量或一定距离内，使用车辆能够持续行驶的时间长度The length of time the scooter can continue to travel within a given battery level or distance.
悬挂Suspension连接车架与车轮的装置，主要负责传递力和力矩以及吸收路面冲击A device connecting the frame and wheels, mainly responsible for transmitting forces and moments and absorbing road impacts.
减震器Shock Absorber用来吸收路面冲击的部件，可提升骑行舒适性A component used to absorb road impacts and improve riding comfort.
方向指示灯/转向灯Direction Indicator / Turn Signal指示车辆转向意图的设备A device that indicates the scooter's intended turning direction.
日行灯Daytime Running Light在白天提高车辆可见性的设备A device that improves scooter visibility during the daytime.
前灯Headlight & Front Position照明设备，可提高夜间行驶安全性A lighting device that improves riding safety at night.
尾灯Taillight可提示后方来车，确保夜间行驶的安全性Alerts traffic behind the scooter and helps ensure safe riding at night.
05
SERVICE PRECAUTIONS

维修注意事项Service Precautions

拆装、复检、防水、防静电、固件及胎压要求。Requirements for disassembly/assembly, reinspection, waterproofing, electrostatic protection, firmware, and tire pressure.

拆卸电池放电线束或接口后，需要立即长按开机键 5 秒进行放电处理。After disconnecting the battery discharge wire harness or connector, immediately press and hold the power button for 5 seconds to discharge the system.
装配过程中需进行二次检验，检查螺钉无漏装、错装，确保拧紧到位且无松动。Perform a second inspection during assembly. Check that no screws are missing or installed incorrectly and ensure all screws are tightened correctly with no looseness.
拆卸过程中有硅胶的位置，安装时也需要打上硅胶，保证防水性。Where silicone sealant is present during disassembly, apply silicone sealant again during assembly to maintain waterproofing.
各位置螺钉扭力值需要按照拆装视频中的扭力值执行。Apply the screw torque values for each location according to the values specified in the service video.
维修装配完成后，必须检查所有零件及螺钉，确保无缺失、无多余。After service and assembly are completed, check all parts and screws to ensure that none are missing and that no extra parts remain.
拆装车辆时，必须佩戴防静电手环，避免静电放电损坏电子元件。Wear an anti-static wrist strap when disassembling or assembling the scooter to prevent electrostatic discharge from damaging electronic components.
维修完成后连接 APP 检查车辆固件版本，如需更新需提示用户升级。After service is completed, connect the APP and check the scooter firmware version. If an update is required, inform the user to update it.
更换仪表（三代车）或者控制器（三代以前）后，需要使用售后 APP 修改 SN 号并同步数据。After replacing the Dashboard (3rd-generation models) or Controller (earlier-generation models), use the After-sales APP to rewrite the SN and synchronize the data.
维修完成后需将充气轮胎打至标准胎压，约 45 psi。After service is completed, inflate the pneumatic tire to the standard tire pressure, approximately 45 psi.

1 车辆关机后，后轮无法触发防盗报警 After the scooter is powered off, moving the rear wheel does not trigger the anti-theft alarm. 仪表 Dashboard
填写日期Date：2026-06-01 车型Model：G3 故障分类Fault Category： 硬件故障Hardware Fault
视频 / 图片Video / Image 源表未提供Not provided in the source sheet

故障处理Troubleshooting / Resolution

排查思路：
触发车辆异动报警的条件有：
1. 在 APP 中开启了异动报警选项；
2. 车辆不在充电状态；
3. 车辆关机时间超过 5 秒；
4. 车辆蓝牙没有与手机连接（需要在手机设置里关闭蓝牙）；
5. 车辆出现震动（非电机轮转动，仪表上的陀螺仪感应到震动）。

排查步骤：
1. 先满足触发异动报警的条件；
2. 在 APP 开启折叠后自动关机功能，检查折叠是否能关机；如不能关机，说明陀螺仪故障，更换仪表板；
3. 以上都排除后，更换仪表板总成。 Troubleshooting approach:
The scooter movement alarm is triggered only when all of the following conditions are met:
1. The movement alarm option is enabled in the APP;
2. The scooter is not charging;
3. The scooter has been powered off for more than 5 seconds;
4. The scooter Bluetooth is not connected to the phone (Bluetooth must be turned off in the phone settings);
5. The scooter is physically shaken. Rear motor-wheel rotation alone does not count; the gyroscope in the dashboard must detect vibration.

Troubleshooting steps:
1. First make sure all movement-alarm trigger conditions are met;
2. Enable automatic power-off after folding in the APP and check whether folding powers off the scooter. If it does not, the gyroscope is faulty; replace the Dashboard;
3. If the above conditions have all been ruled out, replace the Dashboard Assembly.

根因分析Root Cause Analysis

仪表内的陀螺仪通过中断信号唤醒 VCU，中断信号回路里的二极管焊接不良导致 VCU 无法正常被唤醒。 The gyroscope in the dashboard wakes the VCU through an interrupt signal. Poor soldering of the diode in the interrupt-signal circuit prevents the VCU from being woken normally.

2 用户在手机 APP 上点休眠后，APP 页面倒计时结束后，车辆并没有关机休眠。 After Sleep is selected in the mobile APP and the countdown ends, the scooter does not power off and enter sleep mode. 电池 Battery
填写日期Date：2026-06-01 车型Model：G3 故障分类Fault Category： 硬件故障Hardware Fault
视频 / 图片Video / Image 源表未提供Not provided in the source sheet

故障处理Troubleshooting / Resolution

排查思路：
电池有充放电电流，不满足休眠条件。

排查步骤：
1. 充电状态和关键状态车辆无法进入休眠模式，请将车辆开机，并拔掉充电器后再通过 APP 点击休眠；
2. 开机状态下长按开机键 15 秒，仪表重启后再次尝试；
3. 仍然无效需通过 APP 查看电池详情，查看当前电流。如果充放电流＜0.5A，则更换电池（负数表示放电，正数表示充电）；如果放电电流＞0.5A，需要关闭前灯，保持车辆静止，然后再点休眠；仍然无效则更换控制器或仪表板。 Troubleshooting approach:
The battery has charging or discharging current and therefore does not meet the conditions for entering sleep mode.

Troubleshooting steps:
1. The scooter cannot enter sleep mode while charging or in certain critical operating states. Power on the scooter, unplug the charger, and then select Sleep in the APP;
2. With the scooter powered on, press and hold the power button for 15 seconds. After the dashboard restarts, try again;
3. If the issue remains, check Battery Details in the APP and review the current value. If the charge/discharge current is below 0.5 A, replace the Battery (a negative value indicates discharge and a positive value indicates charging). If the discharge current is above 0.5 A, turn off the headlight, keep the scooter stationary, and select Sleep again. If the issue still remains, replace the Controller or Dashboard.

根因分析Root Cause Analysis

电池处于充电或者放电的工况下，电池不会进入休眠模式。满足工况仍然不进入休眠，则更换电池。 The battery will not enter sleep mode while it is charging or discharging. If the operating conditions are satisfied but the battery still does not enter sleep mode, replace the Battery.

3 捏刹车轮子无法抱死 The wheel cannot lock when the brake lever is applied. 碟刹座/来令片 Disc Brake Caliper / Brake Pads
填写日期Date：2026-06-01 车型Model：G3 故障分类Fault Category： 软件故障Software Fault
视频 / 图片Video / Image 源表未提供Not provided in the source sheet

故障处理Troubleshooting / Resolution

排查思路：
来令片磨损导致刹车夹不紧。

排查步骤：
查看车辆生产日期：
• ≤2543：更换新的碟刹座；
• ＞2543：先调节碟刹座，如无法调节好，更换碟刹座和碟刹盘。
维修完成后需将用户车辆固件版本升级到最新。 Troubleshooting approach:
Brake-pad wear prevents the brake from clamping tightly enough.

Troubleshooting steps:
Check the scooter production date:
• ≤2543: replace the Disc Brake Caliper;
• >2543: first adjust the Disc Brake Caliper. If it cannot be adjusted correctly, replace the Disc Brake Caliper and Brake Disc.
After the repair is completed, update the scooter firmware to the latest version.

根因分析Root Cause Analysis

1. 早期固件无电刹，导致来令片磨损严重；
2. 早期碟刹座在来令片磨损严重时，会对刹车线造成挤压，极端情况下会导致刹车线断裂。 1. Early firmware did not provide electronic braking, which caused severe brake-pad wear;
2. On early disc brake calipers, severe brake-pad wear can place excessive pressure on the brake cable and, in extreme cases, cause the cable to break.

4 更换仪表板后达不到最大速度 The scooter cannot reach maximum speed after the Dashboard is replaced. 仪表总成 Dashboard Assembly
填写日期Date：2026-06-01 车型Model：G3 故障分类Fault Category： 软件故障Software Fault
视频 / 图片Video / Image 源表未提供Not provided in the source sheet

故障处理Troubleshooting / Resolution

排查思路：
如果是新换的仪表板，更换了整车 SN，但是速度仍然是 25km/h，无法达到原来速度。

排查步骤：
更换新的仪表板后，需用户或者后台将原账号解绑，然后使用九号出行 APP 的普通账号连车绑定车辆，即可恢复正常。
绑定后需再次解绑，避免用户无法绑定。 Troubleshooting approach:
After a new Dashboard is installed and the vehicle SN is changed, the speed may remain limited to 25 km/h and fail to return to the original maximum speed.

Troubleshooting steps:
After replacing the Dashboard, the original account must be unbound by the user or through the backend. Then use a standard Segway Mobility APP account to connect to and bind the scooter. Normal speed configuration should then be restored.
After the process is completed, unbind the temporary account again so that the end user can bind the scooter normally.

根因分析Root Cause Analysis

早期因仪表板配件包程序问题，导致新更换的仪表板需要重新激活才能初始化配置。 Because of an early Dashboard service-parts software issue, a newly replaced Dashboard must be reactivated before its configuration can be initialized.

5 车辆开机静止状态下，转动车把，自动关机 While the powered-on scooter is stationary, turning the handlebar causes the scooter to power off automatically. 仪表总成 Dashboard Assembly
填写日期Date：2026-06-01 车型Model：G3 故障分类Fault Category： 软件故障Software Fault
视频 / 图片Video / Image 源表未提供Not provided in the source sheet

故障处理Troubleshooting / Resolution

排查思路：
可能是线束接触不良，或者触发了折叠自动关机。

排查步骤：
仪表板内部陀螺仪异常，更换仪表板解决。 Troubleshooting approach:
The issue may be caused by a poor wire-harness connection or by the automatic power-off-after-folding function being triggered incorrectly.

Troubleshooting steps:
The gyroscope inside the Dashboard is abnormal. Replace the Dashboard.

根因分析Root Cause Analysis

陀螺仪姿态数据异常，导致将拐弯识别成折叠。 Abnormal gyroscope attitude data causes a turning movement to be incorrectly recognized as folding.

6 双充时间过长 Dual-charging time is too long. 未填写 Not provided
填写日期Date：2026-06-02 车型Model：G3 故障分类Fault Category： 未填写Not provided
视频 / 图片Video / Image 源表未提供Not provided in the source sheet

故障处理Troubleshooting / Resolution

排查思路：
购买的非快充充电器或快充充电器是其它车型的。

排查步骤：
1. 查看充电器规格参数，如功率是 70W，说明是非快充充电器，本身充电功率就比较小；
2. 1.3A Turbo（MAX 3.9A）充电器在 2026 年 2 月份将优化通讯电路，销售配件会适配 G3 的内置充电器，实现双充电器快充；在此之前购买的充电器，或购买的其它车型的充电器，会存在不兼容情况，只能有一个充电器处于快充状态。 Troubleshooting approach:
The purchased charger may be a non-fast charger, or the fast charger may be intended for another model.

Troubleshooting steps:
1. Check the charger specifications. If the rated power is 70 W, it is not a fast charger and its charging power is inherently lower;
2. The 1.3 A Turbo (MAX 3.9 A) charger communication circuit is scheduled to be optimized for compatibility with the G3 built-in charger, enabling fast charging with two chargers. Chargers purchased before this update, or chargers intended for other models, may be incompatible, so only one charger can operate in fast-charging mode.

根因分析Root Cause Analysis

旧版本外置充电器和内置充电器充电时会相互干扰，充电器默认输出 1.3A 低功率，导致充电时间过长。新版充电器优化了通讯电路，从而实现双快充功率输出。 Older external chargers and the built-in charger can interfere with each other during charging. The charger then defaults to a low 1.3 A output, resulting in a long charging time. The newer charger optimizes the communication circuit so that both chargers can provide fast-charging output.

7 外挂电池升级失败 External Battery firmware update fails. 外挂电池/充电线 External Battery / Charging Cable
填写日期Date：2026-06-02 车型Model：G3 故障分类Fault Category： 硬件故障Hardware Fault
视频 / 图片Video / Image 源表未提供Not provided in the source sheet

故障处理Troubleshooting / Resolution

排查思路：
1. 通过 APP 查看外挂电池信息显示是否正常，版本号是否正确；
2. 车辆信息里没有电池 2 信息，但是 APP 提示外挂电池升级，这是由于外挂电池在车上时 APP 检测到了新固件，拔掉外挂电池后 APP 缓存了升级的状态，但在实际升级时，无法写入外挂电池信息，从而报错。

排查步骤：
1. 从车辆信息里看到只有 1 块电池，应重新安装外挂电池，确保外挂电池安装牢固；
2. 仍然无法识别外挂电池，可能是外挂电池损坏或充电线损坏。 Troubleshooting approach:
1. Check the External Battery information in the APP and confirm that the displayed information and firmware version are correct;
2. If Vehicle Information does not show Battery 2 but the APP prompts for an External Battery update, the APP may have detected new firmware while the External Battery was installed and cached the update status after the battery was removed. During the actual update, the APP cannot write information to the External Battery and reports an error.

Troubleshooting steps:
1. If Vehicle Information shows only one battery, reinstall the External Battery and make sure it is firmly installed;
2. If the External Battery still cannot be recognized, the External Battery or charging cable may be damaged.

根因分析Root Cause Analysis

外挂电池或充电线损坏，导致车辆无法正常识别到外挂电池。 A damaged External Battery or charging cable prevents the scooter from recognizing the External Battery correctly.

8 车辆捏刹车、开转向灯、开前灯等动作，车辆会 10 号报警 Applying the brake, turning on a turn signal, or turning on the headlight can trigger Error 10. 转向灯/前灯/尾灯 Turn Signal / Headlight / Taillight
填写日期Date：2026-06-02 车型Model：G3 故障分类Fault Category： 硬件故障Hardware Fault
视频 / 图片Video / Image 源表未提供Not provided in the source sheet

故障处理Troubleshooting / Resolution

排查思路：
灯光问题引起的 10 号报警，一般是灯光短路导致的车辆通讯中断。

排查步骤：
通过控制转向灯、前灯、尾灯的亮灭来观察 10 号报警的发生与否。
注意：10 号报警是通讯故障，车辆报错和消失会有延迟，在操作完灯光后需等待 5 秒以上来判断是否因灯光导致报警。
如确认某个灯光导致，更换对应的灯或线束解决。 Troubleshooting approach:
When Error 10 is caused by the lighting system, the usual cause is a lighting short circuit that interrupts scooter communication.

Troubleshooting steps:
Turn the turn signals, headlight, and taillight on and off one at a time and observe whether Error 10 appears.
Note: Error 10 is a communication fault, so both fault appearance and clearing may be delayed. Wait more than 5 seconds after operating a light before determining whether that circuit causes the error.
If a specific lighting circuit is confirmed as the cause, replace the corresponding light or wire harness.

根因分析Root Cause Analysis

灯光短路，当开启短路的灯光回路时会因短路拉低系统电压，导致通讯故障，10 号报警。 A short circuit in a lighting circuit pulls down the system voltage when that light is switched on, causing a communication fault and triggering Error 10.

故障处理Troubleshooting / Resolution

排查思路：
目前已知高概率是电源模块，其次是控制器导致。

排查步骤：
1. 根据目前已知问题，可优先更换电源模块确认；
2. 若未解决，可更换控制器检查。 Troubleshooting approach:
Based on currently known cases, the power module is the most likely cause, followed by the Controller.

Troubleshooting steps:
1. Based on the currently known issue pattern, replace the power module first to verify;
2. If the issue is not resolved, replace the Controller for further confirmation.
